notes.title: Carry, Drive, and Shine: Update 2.1.1
notes.content: Same as Update 2.1.0 but disabled some pickup interaction.

notes.title: Carry, Drive, and Shine: Update 2.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes: Version 2.1

New Features:

    Dead Enemy Pickup: Players can now pick up dead enemies.

Improvements:

    Collision Sensitivity Adjustments: Driving through swarms of enemies has been refined. Increased collision sensitivity reduces the likelihood of vehicles becoming stuck.

Fixes:

    Non-Interactable Object Text Removed: Fixed an issue where non-interactable objects displayed misleading interaction prompts.
    Object Highlight Color Update: Changed the highlight color for interactable objects for better visual clarity and usability.
